title: Bound fixed positive global charging of physical C5 floors
body:
## Summary

```text
23 physical C5 cost 20 floors, all granted
  + fixed nonnegative weights
  + universal termwise restriction domination
  => raw global certificate <=180/7; integer rounding <=26
```

Add one isolated proof/replay package, `research/c5-global-charging-obstruction/`. The all-support term costs 9 globally and 7/8/9 on the local cycles. Both an asymmetric and a signed Gram exact strict fit contain it. Thus direct positive aggregation cannot produce a large global floor. The ceiling need not be attainable, and is not a bound on the actual decoder optimum.

This closes the direct restriction part of the PR3281/3279 global-charging handoff. Local 20 proofs retain their attribution and are granted rather than replayed. Credit Krzysztof Wojt/PR3281, thakrarsagar/PR3256/3232, Nick Petalas/PR3268/3279, Tekalign/PR2782, Arham Tahir/PR2879, Sagar Thakrar/PR2484, Cinna Davis/PR1825, Adam Gall/PR1889, ctoth, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained E8/P112 lineage. Both scientific inputs are canonical-main retained bytes; no pending-PR objects or executables are needed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the 23 local floors lacked a valid global charging implication. The naive unweighted sum charges 193 against 9 on one admissible term.
  **After:** PROOF.md proves every fixed nonnegative universally dominated weight vector has sum <=9/7, with actual full-support rank vector 7x4/8x6/9x13 and two complete strict-fit extensions.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, independent dense-rank/chordless-path reconstruction, seven optimized behavioral/source-boundary controls, Ruff and exact committed-byte/export checks pass. The 12-file scientific export passes all three commands read-only and Git-free under optimized CPython 3.13.16.
- The designated internal read-only peer receipt is in REVIEW.json; CHECKS.json records the source and export evidence. This is a written scoped argument and computational check, not independent human or proof-kernel review.

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c5-global-charging-obstruction
```

Base/refreshed canonical main 463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a, priority revision 6. Scientific commit bbc74edb35b305cd197aa242373715c0f48b0230; publication b4d9f52456a66609b629f19fe28c0d1b4a44dc41. Final 13-file publication bytes and read-only export also pass. Submission overlap has 329 open PRs and 2,128 Discussion records through 20:45:17Z with complete pagination; arbitrary diffs, closed history and unpublished work remain outside coverage. TASK.json records the changed scope and Open next questions. Signed or coefficient-sensitive completed-fit arguments, actual decoder optimization, native/physical execution, restoration, precision, supplier admission and kappa remain outside scope. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19004001

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One isolated opt-in package and reproducible evidence. Frozen inputs and shared verification code are unchanged. Archival integration would not admit a supplier or change the selected frontier.
